description.p: Convey is an email application built around conversations, for the GNOME desktop. It allows you to read, find and send email with a straightforward, modern interface.
Convey 是一款為 GNOME 桌面打造、以對話為核心的電子郵件應用程式。其現代化且符合直覺的介面，讓您能夠輕鬆地閱讀、搜尋、寄送電子郵件。
Convey 是个 GNOME 桌面下围绕会话构建的电子邮件应用。它允许您使用一个直观、现代的用户界面阅读、查找和发送电子邮件。

Convey — програма для роботи з електронною поштою, базовою концепцією якої є «спілкування». Програму призначено для стільничного середовища GNOME. Вона надає вам змогу читати, шукати та надсилати електронну пошту. Інтерфейс програми є простим і сучасним.
Convey, GNOME masaüstü için konuşmalar etrafında inşa edilmiş bir e-posta uygulamasıdır. Dolambaçsız çağdaş bir arayüzle e-posta okumanızı, bulmanızı ve göndermenizi sağlar.
Convey är ett e-postprogram byggt kring konversationer för GNOME-skrivbordet. Det låter dig läsa, söka och sända e-post med ett enkelt modernt gränssnitt.
Гери је програм за е-пошту заснован на разговорима, намењен Гномовој радној површи. Омогућава вам да читате, проналазите и шаљете е-пошту кроз једноставно, савремено прочеље.
Program Convey je odjemalec elektronske pošte za namizje GNOME, zasnovan za napredno zlaganja pogovorov. Omogoča branje, iskanje in pošiljanje sporočil v preglednem modernem vmesniku.
Convey — приложение эл. почты для рабочего стола GNOME, построенное по принципу обмена сообщениями — беседами. Позволяет читать, находить и отправлять эл. почту с простым, современным интерфейсом.
Convey este o aplicație de e-mail construită în jurul conversațiilor, pentru desktopul GNOME. Vă permite să citiți, să găsiți și să trimiteți e-mailuri cu o interfață simplă și modernă.
Convey é um aplicativo de e-mail construído em conversas, para o ambiente do GNOME. Ele permite que você leia, localize e envie e-mail com uma interface simples e moderna.

O Convey é uma aplicação de correio eletrónico criada em torno de conversas, para o ambiente de trabalho GNOME. Permite-lhe ler, encontrar e enviar correio eletrónico com uma interface simples e moderna.
Convey to nowoczesny klient poczty dla środowiska GNOME zbudowany wokół wątków. Umożliwia czytanie, wyszukiwanie i wysyłanie wiadomości za pomocą prostego, nowoczesnego interfejsu.
Convey is een e-mailtoepassing die draait om gesprekken, voor de GNOME-bureaubladomgeving. Via de duidelijke, moderne interface kunt u e-mails lezen, zoeken en verzenden.
Convey - бұл сөйлесулер негізінде жасалған эл. пошта қолданбасы, GNOME жұмыс үстелі үшін арналған. Оның көмегімен тура, замануи интерфейсін қолданып, эл. поштаны оқу, табу және жіберуге болады.
Convey è un'applicazione di posta elettronica basata sulle conversazioni, per l'ambiente desktop GNOME. Permette di leggere, trovare e inviare email con un'interfaccia semplice e moderna.
Convey adalah aplikasi surel yang dibangun di sekitar percakapan, bagi desktop GNOME. Memungkinkan Anda membaca, mencari, dan mengirim surel dengan antar muka yang modern, mudah.
A Convey egy e-mail alkalmazás, amely a társalgások köré szerveződik, és a GNOME asztalhoz készült. Segítségével e-maileket olvashat, kereshet és küldhet egy lényegre törő és modern felületen.
‏Convey הוא יישם דוא״ל הבנוי סביב תכתובות, עבור שולחן העבודה GNOME. הוא מאפשר לקרוא, למצוא ולשלוח דוא״ל עם ממשק חדיש ופשוט.
Convey é unha aplicación de correo-e construída ao redor das conversas, feita para o escritorio GNOME 3. Permítelle ler, buscar e enviar correos de forma rápida e nunha interface moderna.

Convey est une application de messagerie construite autour de conversations, pour le bureau GNOME. Elle permet de lire, rechercher et envoyer des courriels de façon simple, avec une interface élégante.
Convey on keskustelujen ympärille rakennettu sähköpostisovellus Gnome-työpöydälle. Sen avulla voit lukea, etsiä ja lähettää sähköpostia modernin käyttöliittymän kautta.
گیری برنامهٔ رایانامه‌ای ساخته برای میزکار گنوم حول گفت‌وگوست. این برنامه می‌گذارد رایانامه‌ها را با رابطی ساده و نوین خوانده، جسته و بفرستید.
Convey is an email application built around conversations, for the GNOME desktop. It allows you to read, find and send email with a straightforward, modern interface.

Το Convey είναι μια εφαρμογή ηλεκτρονικού ταχυδρομείου που βασίζεται σε συνομιλίες για την επιφάνεια εργασίας GNOME. Σας επιτρέπει να διαβάζετε, να βρίσκετε και να στέλνετε μηνύματα ηλεκτρονικού ταχυδρομείου με μια απλή, σύγχρονη διεπαφή.
Convey ist ein E-Mail-Programm für GNOME mit Fokus auf Konversationen. Es ermöglicht das einfache Lesen, Finden und Schreiben von E-Mails in einer übersichtlichen und modernen Benutzeroberfläche.
Convey er et lille e-mailprogram til GNOME-skrivebordet, som er bygget op omkring samtaler. Det lader dig læse, finde og sende e-mail via en enkel, moderne brugerflade.
Convey je poštovní aplikace pro uživatelské prostředí GNOME, která se soustředí na konverzace jako celek. Umožňuje číst, vyhledávat a odesílat e-maily v přímočarém a moderním prostředí.

Conversațiile vă permit să citiți o discuție completă fără a trebui să căutați și să navigați de la mesaj la mesaj.
As conversas permitem que você leia uma discussão completa sem ter que procurar e clicar de mensagem em mensagem.

description.p: Features:

ul.li: A new look, combining the conversation list with the message viewer
PGP encryption and decryption with Autocrypt support
A signature for each sender address
Formatting and images in signatures
Show the conversation subject above the conversation viewer
Configurable line order in the conversation list
Add an unread filter to the search bar
Add a button to unsubscribe from mailing lists
Add Reply to List button for mailing lists
Add proper spell-check support
Manual proxy configuration

description.p: Bug fixes:

ul.li: Search all accounts at once from All Inboxes
Discard untouched replies instead of saving empty drafts
Mark emails read when scrolling a conversation thread
Email colours now follow GNOME's light and dark switch when HTML override is enabled
Stop spam in Outlook accounts from sending notifications
Fix unread counts not resetting after deleting email
Handle long messages instead of failing to render
Fix duplicate emails opening from notifications
Fix mailto: links being ignored when Convey isn't already running
Fix "View Source" not working for Flatpak builds
Point the bug report and website links to Convey instead of Geary
Fix clicking a folder's arrow not expanding or collapsing it
"Automatically select next message" honoured after deleting
Fix special folders not being found in some cases
Force Ctrl+Z to only act within the textbox when a textbox is focused
Fix the email font not following the system's document font
Fix saved drafts gaining extra line breaks in Microsoft accounts
Make "Delete" the default in permanent delete dialogs
Show nested folders on Microsoft accounts
Create subfolders from the folder list context menu within the app
Open GNOME Online Accounts directly when adding an account
Refreshed application icons, screenshots and branding colours
Add a combined "All Inboxes" view spanning every account
Reopen the inbox last viewed at launch, or a fixed one of your choosing
Remember which parts of the folder list were left collapsed
Add a Starred folder for Microsoft accounts, showing its total count
Page through large folders on Graph accounts
Persist folders from Graph accounts so they load offline
Fix unpredictable folder keyboard navigation
Deselect conversations on Escape, disable autoselect in Trash and Junk
Fix dark mode rendering in certain emails
Fix context menu positioning in the message body
Replace libcanberra and gsound with GStreamer for notification sounds
Drop the unused libspelling dependency
Numerous user interface and styling fixes

description.p: The first Convey release, forked from Geary 46.0.
Enhancements included in this release:

ul.li: Ported the interface to GTK4 and libadwaita
Added a Microsoft Graph backend for Outlook and Microsoft 365 accounts
Rebranded as Convey, with new application icons
Create, rename and delete folders from the sidebar
Reworked conversation list with keyboard navigation between panes
Message colours now follow the system light and dark preference immediately
Redrawn notification avatars, rendered at the display's pixel density
Reworked address completion as a navigable dropdown
Ported plugins to libpeas-2 and migrated to gcr-4 and gck-2
Numerous bug fixes and user interface improvements
